summary_1line: Disguised during exile, Yudhishthira enters Virata’s court as the gambler Kanka and is welcomed into service, while Bhima soon approaches disguised as a cook.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira, hiding golden dice in his cloth, steps into King Virata’s court while the king studies the noble stranger who shines like the moon behind clouds.
King Virata sits among courtiers, gazing in astonishment at the regal-looking stranger who approaches him confidently like an elephant moving through lotuses.
Bhima, massive and radiant, arrives before Virata dressed as a cook, holding a ladle and spoon while a dark unsheathed sword hangs at his side.
